_meta.name: English (Early Modern)
_meta.notes: The default language and the fallback for every other. Keys are looked up as dotted paths ("nav.search"). {name} is a placeholder: keep it, move it where thy grammar wants it. An object with "one"/"other" (and any other Intl.PluralRules category of thy locale: zero, two, few, many) is a plural, chosen by the {count} parameter. A new language is web/lang/<code>.json with the keys it translates (missing ones fall back to this file) plus a line in LANGUAGES in web/js/i18n.js.

api.unreachable: The ThyTube server answereth not. Art thou upon thine own network?

theme.autoNow: The theme now followeth thy device.

reason.noInclude: the title matcheth not the pattern
reason.exclude: the title matcheth the forbidden pattern
reason.beyondBackfill: made before the subscription (beyond the backfill)

profiles.name: Name
profiles.confirmDelete: Shall the profile “{name}” be struck out? Its history of watching goeth with it.
profiles.rename: What shall it now be called?

filter.intro: A subscription is but a sieve: such new uploads as pass through it are downloaded of their own accord. The patterns are Python regular expressions, and match wheresoever in the title they fall.
filter.backfillNew: Fetch also this many videos already made

backfillMore.one: Upon saving, one more of the channel's older videos shall be queued.
backfillMore.other: Upon saving, as many as {count} more of the channel's older videos shall be queued.

filter.backfillLess: Upon saving, older videos beyond this number shall leave the queue; such as be cached already remain till they be cast out.
filter.subscribed: Thou art subscribed to {channel}; the backfill is queued.
filter.updatedBackfill: The subscription is amended; the backfill runneth anew.
filter.wouldCache: Of {total} recent uploads, {matched} would be cached
filter.previewError: The channel's uploads could not be fetched: {error}
filter.previewNote: Duration, Shorts and streams are weighed again, with full particulars, at the hour of download.

channel.notSubscribed: Thou art not subscribed. Here be only such videos as thou hast cached by hand.
channel.empty: As yet no video of this channel is cached.

library.title: Library
library.emptyHint: Find a video or a creator by way of {search} and cache it, or subscribe thee to a channel.

unsubscribedDeleting.one: Thou art unsubscribed; one cached video is being removed.
unsubscribedDeleting.other: Thou art unsubscribed; {count} cached videos are being removed.

manage.noSubsHint: Find a creator by way of {search} and choose “{action}”.
manage.unsubMessage: New uploads from {channel} shall be cached no more.

alsoDelete.one: Delete also its one cached video (such as are held fast are kept)
alsoDelete.other: Delete also its {count} cached videos (such as are held fast are kept)

manage.otherwise: Else they remain, and are removed in the common way when room is wanted.
manage.unavailable: Not to be had on YouTube
manage.disk: The disk: {free} free of {total}; ThyTube leaveth ever {min} free.
manage.evictionRule: The least re-watched go first, then the longest unwatched, then the largest. Unwatched downloads of the last {days} days are spared unless naught else remaineth; videos held fast, and whatsoever is playing at this present, are never removed.
manage.nothingRemovable: There is naught that may be removed.

search.placeholder: Search YouTube, or lay a video or channel link here
search.intro: Searches are made by yt-dlp upon the server. Lay herein a link to a video or a channel to go thither straightway.

explain.ok: Downloads and the watching of channels go forward as they ought.
explain.updating: yt-dlp is being renewed. Downloads shall resume once the new version hath proved itself.
explain.degraded: Some requests to YouTube do miscarry ({reason}). Downloads go on, yet may cease if this continueth.
explain.blocked: YouTube barreth the way to downloads; we await a mending of yt-dlp, or that the bar be lifted.

status.workerDownHint: Downloads and the watching of channels are at a stand. Start it with `thytube worker`, or look to its service.
status.rollbackTitle: Return yt-dlp to its former version?
status.rollbackMessage: This taketh up again the yt-dlp that was installed before. The next appointed renewal may bring it forward once more.
status.installed: Thou usest ThyTube as an installed app.
status.canInstall: Install ThyTube upon this device: it openeth in a window of its own, and its icon sitteth beside thine other apps.
status.iosInstall: To install it upon this device, tap the Share button in Safari, and then {add}.
status.needsHttps: Thy browser offereth not to install ThyTube (nor keepeth it usable offline) save when the server is reached over HTTPS. The README showeth how to set that up upon thy LAN; till then, thy browser's “Add to Home screen” maketh a shortcut nonetheless.
status.browserInstall: Install ThyTube by way of thy browser's menu (“Install app” or “Add to Home screen”).

watch.channelOdds: — the less watched come up twice as oft
watch.noOthers: There is no other cached video of {channel}.
watch.removeFromQueue: Take it out of the queue
watch.playNextInQueue: Play the next in the queue
watch.queueEmpty: Thy queue standeth empty. Use “{action}” upon any video.
watch.removing: The cached file is being removed…
watch.loadError: This video could not be fetched
watch.pinnedNote: A video held fast is never removed of itself.
watch.removeTitle: Shall the cached file be removed?
watch.removeMessage: The video abideth in thy library (with its thumbnail) and may be cached anew hereafter.
